mechanism_narrative: A rising month-over-month CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals persistent price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% over 3 months), the labor market tightness supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (3-month), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity and overall economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising INDPRO periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3.0% year-over-year) and stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 5.5%) signal improving economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 5.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong aggregate demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise quarter-over-quarter, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
